title: Haben Fabrics
summary: Haben Fabrics, an Ethiopian trading company that specializes in importing premium fabrics tailored for dresses.

blocks.body: Haben Fabrics, an Ethiopian trading company that specializes in importing premium fabrics tailored for dresses. The client wanted a Visual identity that uniquely identifies their brand story while appealing as both B2B (as a Fabric Vendor ) and B2C (as a Tailor made Dress Store) Brand. The project was a interesting journey toward building a brand identity lead with a logo design with elements that radiate the essence of the brand promise.
